name: grw-lab
description: Free agent skills from grw—lab: video breakdowns, Arabic and RTL, agent-ready web, Saudi e-invoicing, freelance quoting, design tokens, and safe deploys.

plugins.name: agent-ready-site
plugins.description: Makes a site readable by AI agents: llms.txt, Markdown twins, crawler rules, and JSON-LD.

plugins.name: arabic-copy
plugins.description: Writes natural Arabic UI and marketing copy: register, gender-neutral address, punctuation, and numbers.

plugins.name: arabic-localization
plugins.description: Takes an app to Arabic: six plural forms, digits, currency, Gregorian and Hijri dates, and fonts.

plugins.name: arabic-seo
plugins.description: SEO for Arabic and bilingual sites: hreflang, dialect keywords, Arabic slugs, and local signals.

plugins.name: design-tokens-extractor
plugins.description: Pulls a design system out of a site or CSS into CSS variables, Tailwind, and DTCG tokens.

plugins.name: freelance-quote
plugins.description: Turns a client brief into a priced quote with ranges, a buffer, and the terms that protect the job.

plugins.name: rtl-ui
plugins.description: Audits and fixes right-to-left interfaces: logical CSS, icon mirroring, bidi text, and forms.

plugins.name: shared-server-deploy
plugins.description: Changes one site on a shared server without breaking the sites next to it.

plugins.name: video-reader
plugins.description: Turns a video into a contact sheet, key frames, cut times, and audio numbers.

plugins.name: zatca-invoice
plugins.description: Saudi e-invoice basics: the ZATCA QR code, VAT math, and the required fields.

plugins.name: client-brief
plugins.description: Turns a messy client message into a one-page brief with scope and open questions.

plugins.name: product-sheet
plugins.description: Turns a product CSV into slugs and a VAT split. You write the Arabic titles.

plugins.name: ui-inventory
plugins.description: Lists the font sizes, colors, and corner radii already used in local HTML and CSS.

plugins.name: vat-worksheet
plugins.description: Sums sales and purchase VAT from a CSV into a worksheet. Not a filed return.

plugins.name: grw-skills
plugins.description: Every grw—lab skill in one install. Install a single skill by its own name when you only need one.
